card.law_is_about: Adding land-register personal data to national register modernisation and NOOTS infrastructure.
card.they_want: Shorten the proposed 2032 implementation deadline for land-register data.
card.the_problem: The statutory general deadline is31December2028, as the exact draft explains. The gap is four months smaller, but remains four years.

draft.addressed_version: Standalone Regelungsentwurf published by the ministry on 20 July 2026; no internal version timestamp printed on the extracted title.
draft.exactness: The author identifies the same standalone proposal and its 2032 transition. Operative pages 2–3 and the memorandum on pages 8–11 match that proposal. A later carrier bill is not substituted.

locator.section: Article X, proposed §18 IDNrG; general deadline explained on physical page 8

correction: IDNrG §2 no.1 requires storage by the end of the fifth calendar year following commencement. Commencement on 31 August 2023 means a deadline of 31 December 2028. The exact draft expressly gives that date. The proposed deadline for land-register data remains the end of 2032.
effect: Slightly weakens the timetable argument for earlier implementation: the gap between the general deadline and the proposed land-register deadline is four years, rather than four years and four months.
limits: The four-year gap remains substantial. Does not establish that2032is appropriate or that the separate requests for cadastral inclusion, technical access and funding are mistaken. No intent inferred.
context_and_alternatives: All six author pages were read, and the claim and request on page 1 were visually checked. The paper calls the date the deadline set for the other IDNrG registers, rather than an aspirational NOOTS target. Confusing a five-year anniversary with the calendar-year rule is a benign explanation. Independent review of the full author context, exact draft and original commencement notice supports the narrow minor finding.
materiality_explanation: Minor timetable-comparison error. Correcting four months leaves a four-year gap and preserves the central argument for synchronisation. No substantial reversal is established.
direction_explanation: The earlier stated comparator enlarges the divergence from2032and marginally strengthens the author’s explicit request to shorten it.

ai_reviews.verdict: Retain the narrow provisional minor finding, favouring the request, after checking the full author text, exact draft and original commencement notice.
